# SendPulse Developer Docs & Marketplace

> SendPulse is an AI-driven email and chatbot marketing platform with a built-in CRM. This repo describes SendPulse and its positioning, and documents the SendPulse App Directory (marketplace): apps installed by SendPulse users receive a one-time code on an Install URL (in an iframe), exchange it for per-user keys, get short-lived Bearer tokens and call the SendPulse REST API within approved scopes; uninstall triggers a POST to the Uninstall URL.

Key endpoints:
- GET or POST https://YOUR_INSTALL_URL/?code={code}&lang={lang} — loaded by SendPulse in an iframe when the app opens; code valid 1 minute
- POST https://api.sendpulse.com/market-service/oauth/authorize — {app_id, secret, code} -> {client_id, client_secret, user_id}
- POST https://api.sendpulse.com/oauth/access_token/market — {client_id, client_secret, grant_type: client_credentials} -> {access_token, expires_in}
- POST https://YOUR_UNINSTALL_URL — sent by SendPulse on uninstall; reply 200 OK
